review.method: Coordinator visually inspected all six unedited named XCTest attachments from the passing full schemes.
observations: Source and selection bindings, raster byte counts/digests, and review headings remain readable at both widths.
The property warning explicitly rejects shared coordinates, alignment, connectivity, and reconstruction.
The actual service-unavailable message, local-work assurance, disclosure confirmation, and recovery actions are visible in both failure captures.
Controls stack on iPhone and fit horizontally on iPad; reviewed critical text does not overlap the fixed toolbar or controls.
Viewport-edge clipping belongs to the normal scrollable content. Colored raster swatches and private revision canaries are synthetic owner-review fixtures.
review.limitations: Bounded layout review, not physical-device touch, VoiceOver, every text size, WCAG certification, or real-room image-quality evidence. The full suites separately exercise largest-text accessibility flows.
